# [CS065] Import Cycle (arch-import-cycle)

Packages of the module import each other in a cycle.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | HIGH |
| **Category** | Architecture |
| **CWE** | - |
| **OWASP** | - |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

Packages that import each other, directly or through other packages, cannot be built: the go command refuses import cycles. The finding lists every package in the cycle so that the dependency to break is visible.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
// package a imports b, and package b imports a
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
// move the shared types into package c, imported by both a and b
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [arch-import-cycle]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    arch-import-cycle: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore arch-import-cycle -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** arch-import-cycle
```
